item.title: 36 Group omstrukturerar finansieringsavtalet med Loft Capital och tecknar avsiktsförklaring om ny finansiering
item.title_en: 36 Group restructures its Loft Capital loan and signs a non-binding letter of intent on new financing

item.summary: 36 Group AB (publ) on 13 November 2026 announced an agreement to restructure its financing arrangement with Loft Capital Limited. Under the agreement, the 0.9885 bitcoin pledged as security is to be sold to reduce the outstanding loan, which the company put at about SEK 4.8 million in October, and the remaining amount, estimated at about SEK 3.7 million after that sale and the exercise of warrants, is to be repaid without interest in six monthly instalments from November 2026 to April 2027, in cash or in shares. A separate loan of SEK 275,000 from August 2026 is to be set off against 1,375,000 new shares at SEK 0.20 per share. The company has also signed a non-binding letter of intent with Loft Structured Opportunities Fund I on convertible financing of up to SEK 11.25 million, which lapses if a final agreement has not been entered into by 30 November 2026.
